question: Across fresh Blender processes with repeated frame-38 renders, does every recurrence of the frozen ALTERNATE PNG mode couple to the pilot-derived Combined-float and BACK_WALL/FLOOR CryptoObject00 coverage modes while closest-sample Depth, Normal and Position remain exact?

evidenceBasis.pilotObservation: One PID produced eleven REFERENCE and one ALTERNATE PNG. The ALTERNATE call coupled to a second Combined-float hash and a second CryptoObject00 hash localized to seven BACK_WALL/FLOOR coverage pixels; Depth, Normal and Position stayed exact. A separate call-1 Vector transient did not couple to Combined.

sourceCodeEvidence.observation: Each image render creates and later deletes a new Eevee Instance.
Image-render sample dimensions are generated from sample-index Halton sequences.
Metal and Vulkan execute GPU_flush and GPU_render_step between render samples.

design.type: twelve fresh persistent processes with twelve repeated same-frame renders and two saves per Render Result
design.frameSetRule: Set frame 38 once before the first render and do not change it between calls.
design.renderRule: Render once with write_still false, then save PNG8 and EXR32 multilayer from the same Render Result without re-rendering.

primaryEndpoint.name: coverageCoupledPassLocalization
primaryEndpoint.coupledReferenceDefinition: A render is COUPLED_REFERENCE when PNG decoded RGB, Combined float and CryptoObject00 float all match their frozen REFERENCE hashes and Depth/Normal/Position match their stable hashes.
primaryEndpoint.coupledAlternateDefinition: A render is COUPLED_ALTERNATE when PNG decoded RGB, Combined float and CryptoObject00 float all match their frozen ALTERNATE hashes and Depth/Normal/Position match their stable hashes.
primaryEndpoint.supportingProcessDefinition: A PID supports localization when it contains at least one COUPLED_REFERENCE and at least one COUPLED_ALTERNATE render.
primaryEndpoint.novelHashRule: Any primary-domain hash outside the frozen sets is retained and takes PASS_SPACE_EXPANDED; it is never coerced.
primaryEndpoint.decouplingRule: Any known primary hashes forming a tuple other than the two frozen coupled tuples takes DECOUPLED_PASS_PATTERN.
primaryEndpoint.dataPassRule: Any Depth, Normal or Position hash outside its frozen stable hash takes CLOSEST_SAMPLE_PASS_VARIATION.

secondaryEndpoints: frequency of COUPLED_REFERENCE and COUPLED_ALTERNATE by PID and call ordinal
whether Vector call 1 matches the frozen first-call hash and calls 2-12 match the frozen steady hash
whether CryptoObject01 and CryptoObject02 remain at their frozen stable hashes
Combined and CryptoObject00 numeric difference pixels, bounding boxes and maximum absolute error
BACK_WALL and FLOOR cryptomatte IDs and coverage weights at changed pixels
PNG and EXR container hashes and render/save times for every call

decisionRule.PASS_SPACE_EXPANDED: The valid experiment observes a primary-domain decoded hash outside the frozen hash sets.
decisionRule.CLOSEST_SAMPLE_PASS_VARIATION: No novel primary hash occurs, but Depth, Normal or Position departs from its frozen stable hash.
decisionRule.DECOUPLED_PASS_PATTERN: No novel or closest-sample variant occurs, but known PNG, Combined and CryptoObject00 hashes form a tuple outside COUPLED_REFERENCE and COUPLED_ALTERNATE.
decisionRule.COVERAGE_COUPLED_LOCALIZATION_SUPPORT: No prior failure occurs and at least two independent PIDs contain both coupled modes.
decisionRule.SINGLE_PID_COUPLING_INCONCLUSIVE: No prior failure occurs and exactly one PID contains both coupled modes.
decisionRule.ALTERNATE_NOT_REPRODUCED: No prior failure occurs and no PID contains a COUPLED_ALTERNATE render.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, source, control, pass, process, call, save, output, layout, binding, contract, attack or human-status gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: source state or fixed control mismatch
enabled pass or cryptomatte setting mismatch
classification, manifest or file-hash binding mismatch
hash-set, sample-size, threshold or decision-rule mutation
explicitNonClaims: Coupled localization would not prove that film resampling, rasterization, Metal, TAA or GPU scheduling is the causal mechanism.
Stable closest-sample passes would not prove geometry processing is globally deterministic; they test only these outputs at this frame and profile.
Enabling diagnostic passes may affect execution or mode frequency, so B29 tests the frozen pass-enabled profile rather than silently generalizing B28 rates.
Cryptomatte coverage weights are diagnostic data, not calibrated perceptual visibility or cinematic-quality scores.
The Vector first-call transient is a separate secondary pattern and does not establish the primary Combined/Crypto mechanism.
Twelve processes by twelve calls is a fixed mechanistic probe, not an equivalence study or universal Blender probability estimate.
Human review remains PENDING and cannot be replaced by machine pass identity.
